text.body: || śrīmadānandarāmāyaṇāntargata śrī rāmāṣṭottaraśatanāmāvaliḥ || dhyānam || mandārākṛti puṇyadhāma vilasat vakṣasthalaṃ komalam śāntaṃ kāntamahendranīla rucirābhāsaṃ sahasrānanam | vandehaṃ raghunandanaṃ surapatiṃ kodaṇḍa dīkṣāguruṃ rāmaṃ sarvajagat susevitapadaṃ sītāmanovallabham || oṃ sahasra śīrṣṇe namaḥ | oṃ sahasrākṣāya namaḥ | oṃ sahasra hastāya namaḥ | oṃ sahasra caraṇāya namaḥ | oṃ jīmūtavarṇāya namaḥ | oṃ viśvatomukhāya namaḥ | oṃ acyutāya namaḥ | oṃ śeṣaśāyine namaḥ | oṃ hiraṇyagarbhāya namaḥ | oṃ pañcabhūtātmane namaḥ | 10 oṃ mūlaprakṛtaye namah | oṃ devānāṃ hitakāriṇe namaḥ | oṃ sarvalokeśāya namaḥ | oṃ sarva duḥkhaniṣūdanāya namaḥ | oṃ śaṅkhacakragadā padmajaṭāmukuṭa dhāriṇe namaḥ | oṃ garbhāya namaḥ | oṃ tatvāya namaḥ | oṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiṣe namaḥ | oṃ vāsudevāya namaḥ | oṃ daśarathātmajāya namaḥ | 20 oṃ rājendrāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvasampatpradāya namaḥ | oṃ kāruṇyarūpāya namaḥ | oṃ kaikeyī priya kāriṇe namaḥ | oṃ dāntāya namaḥ | oṃ śantāya namaḥ | oṃ viśvāmitra priyāya namaḥ | oṃ ya(?)eśāya namaḥ | oṃ kratupālakāya namaḥ | oṃ keśavāya namaḥ | 30 oṃ nāthāya namaḥ | oṃ śārṅgiṇe namaḥ | oṃ rāmacandrāya namaḥ | oṃ nārāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ rāmacandhrāya namaḥ | oṃ mādhavāya namaḥ | oṃ govindāya namaḥ | oṃ paramātmane namaḥ | oṃ viṣṇusvarūpāya namaḥ | oṃ raghunāthāya namaḥ | 40 oṃ nāthanāthāya namaḥ | oṃ madhusūdanāya namaḥ | oṃ trivikramāya namaḥ | oṃ sītāyaḥ pataye namaḥ | oṃ vāmanāya namaḥ | oṃ rāghavāya namaḥ | oṃ śrīdharāya namaḥ | oṃ jānakīvallabhāya namaḥ | oṃ hṛṣīkeśāya namaḥ | oṃ kandarpāya namaḥ | 50 oṃ padmanābhāya namaḥ | oṃ kausalyā harṣakāriṇe namaḥ oṃ rājīva nayanāya namaḥ | oṃ lakṣmaṇāgrajāya namaḥ | oṃ kākutsthāya namaḥ | oṃ dāmodarāya namaḥ | oṃ vibhīṣaṇa paritrātre namaḥ | oṃ saṅkarṣaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ vāsudevāya namaḥ | oṃ śaṅkarapriyāya namaḥ | 60 oṃ pradyumnāya namaḥ | oṃ aniruddhāya namaḥ | oṃ sadasadbhakti rūpāya namaḥ | oṃ puruṣottamāya namaḥ | oṃ adhokṣajāya namaḥ | oṃ saptatālaharāya namaḥ | oṃ kharadūṣaṇasamhartre namaḥ | oṃ śrīnṛsimhāya namaḥ | oṃ acyutāya namaḥ | oṃ setubandhakāya namaḥ | 70 oṃ janārdanāya namaḥ | oṃ hanumadāśrayāya namaḥ | oṃ upendracandravandyāya namaḥ | oṃ mārīcamathanāya namaḥ | oṃ vālipraharaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ sugrīvarājyadāya namaḥ | oṃ jāmadagnyamahādarpaharāya namaḥ | oṃ haraye namaḥ | oṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ | oṃ bharatāgrajāya namaḥ | 80 oṃ pitṛbhaktāya namaḥ | oṃ śatrughnapūrvajāya namaḥ | oṃ ayodhyādhipataye namaḥ | oṃ śatrughna sevitāya namaḥ | oṃ nityāya namaḥ | oṃ satyāya namaḥ | oṃ buddhyādi (?)ānarūpiṇe namaḥ | oṃ advaita brahmarūpāya namaḥ | oṃ (?)ānagamyāya namaḥ | oṃ pūrṇāya namaḥ | 90 oṃ ramyāya namaḥ | oṃ mādhavāya namaḥ | oṃ cidātmane namaḥ | oṃ ayodhyeśāya namaḥ | oṃ śreṣṭhāya namaḥ | oṃ cinmātrāya namaḥ | oṃ parātmane namaḥ | oṃ ahalyoddhāraṇāya namaḥ | oṃ cāpabhaṅgine namaḥ | oṃ sītārāmāya namaḥ | 100 oṃ sevyāya namaḥ | oṃ stutyāya namaḥ | oṃ parameṣṭhine namaḥ | oṃ bāṇahastāya namaḥ | oṃ kodaṇḍadhāriṇe namaḥ | oṃ kabandhahantre namaḥ | oṃ vālihantre namaḥ | oṃ daśagrīvapraṇa samhāra kāriṇe namaḥ | 108 || śrīrāmāṣṭottaraśatanāmāvaliḥ samaptā ||
